plugins.name: workbench
plugins.description: The process core: standalone review and CI-monitoring agents plus direct-use skills (PR filing with autonomous CI/conflict tending, goal handoffs, premise investigations, team-scale QA sweeps, post-change runtime proofs, strict code-quality reviews, PR comment triage, model/effort routing, CI watch-and-fix) and the workbench flow skills (derived from obra/superpowers, MIT) — without onboarding.

plugins.name: toolkit
plugins.description: Optional artifact-making utilities: doc-to-html report pages, ui-demo-video Playwright walkthroughs, arch-map architecture maps, and writing-skills (skill authoring, derived from obra/superpowers, MIT). Install alongside workbench when wanted.
